text: Soleo is the swimming-pool brand of R.P. Industries, S.A., a Portuguese pool maker headquartered in Sobreposta, Braga. The company's own site presents the SOLEO range as its brand; no parent company or state stake appears in its own pages.
short: Soleo is the pool brand of R.P. Industries, S.A. (Braga).

source.name: RP Industries — Empresa page ('Empresas de Piscinas SOLEO')
source.quote: é com a gama SOLEO que a RP INDUSTRIES usufrui de um protagonismo singular no mercado global de empresas de piscinas
